# dayjobdoor/dotfiles

> Ubuntu 26.04 (amd64, arm64) dotfiles managed entirely by mise: packages, system files, firewall, dotfiles, login shell and tools come from `mise bootstrap`. Modules (agent, server, desktop, full, secrets) are mise config environments; `djd` is the CLI. Ships agent sandbox and XFCE/RDP desktop images and an agentOS export.

Run `install.sh`, `djd` and `mise bootstrap` only on disposable machines (containers, VMs). Never commit secrets; values go in age ciphertext through `djd secret set`. Start with AGENTS.md if you change the repository, and with README.md if you install it.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install and the `djd doctor` check, modules, djd, secrets, desktop over RDP, VMs, agentOS, remove, fork, development tasks, and a table of which doc to read when
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): why the design is what it is, covering symlinks, the install flow, modules, hooks, secrets, shell startup, the RDP service, agentOS, Docker images, and CI decisions
- [Reference](docs/reference.md): layout tree, module contents, djd commands, make targets, bootstrap order and hooks, shell startup files, environment variables, XDG locations, RDP security and known limits, agentOS, Docker images
- [CI/CD reference](docs/ci.md): workflows (including docs.yaml), what each test proves, the test map and where a new test goes, repo tasks, running CI with act, the release chain
- [How-to guides](docs/how-to.md): run CI locally, keep a VM after a failed test, try an OrbStack machine, update pinned tools, raise the mise release, handle a Dependabot agentos-core pull request, set your git identity, move an npm config, keep an edit a program made, publish the first release, retry a failed publish, harden the repository settings
- [History](docs/history.md): comparison with budybye/dotfiles, origin, planned work
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents, verification commands including the fast offline tests, where each kind of change and each new test goes, definition of done
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what must never be committed, vulnerability reporting, local override files, age secrets and their limits, GitHub tokens, workflows and releases with recommended repository settings, Docker, server and desktop hardening, known limits of the RDP service, agentOS, checks
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): colors, fonts and theme tokens (google-labs-code/design.md format)

## Configuration

- [mise-config/](mise-config/): the global mise config, linked as ~/.config/mise. config.toml is the base module (it also pins the zsh plugins in `[bootstrap.repos]`) and config.<module>.toml (agent, server, desktop, full, secrets) the others. tasks/djd has the djd commands, hooks/ the hook scripts.
- [home/](home/): dotfiles symlinked into ~
- [mise-tasks/](mise-tasks/): repo tasks (lint:shell, lint:config, lint:workflows, lint:design, lint:docs, lint:secrets, build, test, test:offline, test:desktop, test:vm, ci)
- [mise.toml](mise.toml): the short repo tasks (lint, lint:fix, agentos:*, shell, up, down, pre-commit) and mise settings. Each task declares its own tools.
- [install.sh](install.sh): the installer that `curl | sh` runs
- [.devcontainer/](.devcontainer/): the Dockerfile, the desktop entrypoint, compose.yaml and devcontainer.json
- [cloud-init/](cloud-init/): cloud-init files for the incus, multipass and OrbStack VMs
- [tests/](tests/): the offline tests that `mise run test:offline` runs, VM and app checks, and the tree helper

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/](.github/workflows/): CI, docs, tag, release image and weekly full-module workflows
- [agentos/boot.mjs](agentos/boot.mjs): agentOS export and boot check
- [agentos/software.lock.json](agentos/software.lock.json): the pinned agentOS registry packages
